archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) infused with Organic/Earthy tones

headings.usage: H1-H3 for premium marketing, hero sections, and main app headers. Use tracking-tight for H1/H2.

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, admin dashboard, buttons, data tables. High legibility for schedules.

rules: No generic fonts for headers (No Inter, Roboto, etc.).
Large headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines and small labels must be uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced (tracking-[0.2em]).

primary.description: Vintage Gold - Used for primary actions, loyalty badges, and VIP elements.

secondary.description: Rich Leather - Used for secondary accents and warmth.

rules: Never use pure black or pure white. Always slightly tint or use rich charcoal.
Primary Gold should be used sparingly for CTAs, selected states, and membership badges.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text elements.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (The Crystal Variant): Use for mobile bottom navigation, sticky headers, and modal overlays. `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10`.
Neumorphism (Tactile): Use for selected time slots and active filters. Soft shadows with sharp inner contrasts.
Grid Borders: Use for Admin Dashboard data tables and metric cards. `border-border/20`.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle grain overlay (`bg-noise`) on hero sections or membership cards to create a physical, premium feel.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., `rounded-lg` or `rounded-xl`). Avoid completely sharp or pill-shaped cards unless it's a specific badge or small button.

components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Heavily customize to match dark theme (bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 text-zinc-100 focus:border-gold-500).
components.buttons: Primary: Solid Gold background with inverse text (`bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0D0D0D] hover:bg-[#C5A059]`). Secondary: Outline with Gold border or Ghost.
components.cards: For client-side app, use cardless or flat rectangular containers with 1px subtle borders (`border-white/10`). Add `-translate-y-1` on hover for interactive items.
components.calendar: Shadcn Calendar. Customize active date to use Primary Gold. Days with no availability should be deeply muted and disabled.
components.time_slots: Grid of radio buttons styled as elegant cards. Active state gets a 1px solid Gold border and subtle glow.
components.toasts: Use `sonner` for notifications. Dark mode styled toasts. Location: `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.

client_app.home: Bento Grid strategy (Mode A: Tetris Grid). Top spans for Loyalty Points (Gold gradient or texture), smaller spans for Next Appointment and Quick Rebook.
client_app.booking_flow: Step-by-step full screen or slide-over panels. 1: Service (List view), 2: Date & Time (Calendar + Slot grid), 3: Confirmation.

admin_dashboard.content: Top row summary widgets (Appointments, Revenue). Main area: Data table for appointments with quick-action status dropdowns (Pendente -> Confirmado -> Concluido).

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use `p-6` or `p-8` for card padding. Ensure breathing room between sections.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Click/press states (`active:scale-95`).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`). NO `transition: all`.
motion.page_loads: Staggered entrance animations for service lists and time slots. Framer Motion is highly recommended for page transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings, preferred Gold (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="book-service-btn"`).

hero_backgrounds.description: Premium dark barbershop interior with black and silver chair
hero_backgrounds.usage: Hero section background with heavy overlay (`bg-black/60`) or membership club banner.

service_haircut.usage: Thumbnail or header for standard haircut services.

service_beard.description: Vintage shaving brush and straight razor
service_beard.usage: Thumbnail for beard trim and hot towel shave services.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Always preserve subject. Use `max-h-[80vh]` on mobile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first PWA for clients and a desktop-first Admin dashboard.
Auth: Implement JWT auth with phone + password (not email).
Client Flow: Implement Bento-grid home -> Service Selection -> Date/Time Picker (double-booking validation via 409) -> Confirmation.
Loyalty: Members get 10 pts per service; 100 pts = R$20 voucher.
Membership Club: Ensure UI indicates VIP status (Gold badge). Peak hours (Fri/Sat) should be visually distinct or gated for non-members.
Admin Flow: Dashboard with pending bookings, ability to transition status (Pendente -> Confirmado -> Concluido -> Cancelado).
Frontend Tech: React (JS), Tailwind, Shadcn UI. Backend: FastAPI, MongoDB.
Do not center-align the main App container.
Ensure all Shadcn components (tabs, calendars, dialogs) are installed and customized for the dark luxury theme.

universal_guidelines.1: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use depth, layering, and z-index hierarchy.
universal_guidelines.2: NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for premium feel).
universal_guidelines.4: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and key UI elements for robust testing.
universal_guidelines.5: Do not use fully transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays. Use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`.
